PUH-BrianMartell- T324 is the paper that finally eliminates the free parameters in the lattice coupling. After T320 (harmonic term), T321 (need for unique quartic term) and T323 (wave speed cannot fix the normalisation), the count of undetermined quantities had risen to three: J, K and \kappa. T324 shows that the count was wrong. The lattice field is dimensionless, so its scale \kappa is only a choice of units. Under rescaling, the only invariant combinations are J/\kappa^2 and K/\kappa^4. These two quantities are the entire physical content of the coupling; \kappa itself is not physical and must drop out of every measurable prediction. Both invariants are now fixed: •  J/\kappa^2 = 1/(60\mu_0) from the potential-term / wave-speed matching, •  K/\kappa^4 from matching the birefringence that emerges automatically from the unique quartic term to the parameter-free QED prediction.
